primitives.name: Slate Shape Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Week 5 Highlights Claim: The slate shape is defined by QB turnover (Mayfield, Lamar, Caleb), an Eagles teardown, a 9-point SNF flip, London book chaos, and rain.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'time unit (game time)', 'Q': 'quarterback turnover event (dimensionless)', 'E': 'Eagles teardown event (dimensionless)', 'F': 'SNF flip factor (point value)', 'L': 'London book disagreement (dimensionless)', 'R': 'rain impact (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Slate shape is deterministic function of exogenous events; each event contributes additive weight to overall slate complexity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Q + E + F + L + R > threshold, implies high variance in expected value distribution.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a combinatorial game tree where each node represents a possible slate configuration under given constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: number of games with >5% line movement; derived: entropy of expected value distributions.

primitives.name: Injury Tracker
primitives.verbatim_quote: Injury Tracker Claim: Every material Week 5 injury with Wed status and source; flag items that move prices.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'I': 'injury severity index (0–100)', 'W': 'Wednesday status flag (boolean)', 'P': 'price movement indicator (percentage change)'}
primitives.assumptions: Injury severity correlates linearly with price volatility; W determines inclusion in model.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When I > 70 and W = true, P becomes stochastic variable with high variance.

layer2.mapping: Derives conditional probability density over player availability and projected performance.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: daily price changes in affected players; derived: posterior belief over lineup viability.

primitives.name: Salary Board Consistency
primitives.verbatim_quote: DK Salary Board Claim: Identical pricing across all classic slates (Main/Early/Thu-Mon/Sun-Mon); only Showdowns differ.
primitives.assumptions: Market efficiency implies identical S across C; D differs due to unique contest structure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If S(C) ≠ S(C') for any C,C', then market inefficiency detected.

layer2.mapping: Models salary board as a partitioned graph where nodes represent players and edges represent pricing consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: cross-slate salary divergence; derived: entropy of salary distribution across slates.

Price movement P is modeled as a stochastic process conditioned on I and W. The salary board consistency enforces a constraint that S(C) = S(C') for all classic slates, enabling a uniformity check via graph partitioning. These primitives form a coherent system where information propagation from external sources (injuries, lines, weather) influences internal state representations (player probabilities, salary structures). Failure modes include overfitting to past trends, ignoring emergent dynamics, and misalignment between observed and inferred variables.
